sloka: कुश चीर परिक्षिप्तम् ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम् ।यथा प्रदीप्तम् दुर्दर्शम् गगने सूर्य मण्डलम् ॥३-१-२॥
transliteration: kuśa cīra parikṣiptam brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam ।yathā pradīptam durdarśam gagane sūrya maṇḍalam ॥3-1-2॥

translations.english: They (the hermitages) were strewn all over with kusa grass and robes by bark with auspicious sacrificial materials around and hence dazzling like the orb of the sun in the sky difficult to gaze.
